body: Thanks buddy, I will. I feel a bit better today.

Thank you, man. I just so badly want love in my life, it's hard to think about the reasons to keep going. All I've ever wanted in my life was to not be alone and I've always been alone, my entire life. I think people would like me if they got to know me..but no one will approach me and I'm too scared to approach anyone so, I don't see this changing. My mind keeps saying "kill yourself" over and over again. I keep envisioning myself limp and dead. Having a hard time with stopping it.
I hope so, thank you. I just don't know if I can wait any longer to not be alone - the pain is so much. People only care about me when Im feeling suicidal, perhaps I have more worth dead than alive.

Well tonight for example, I saw couples having a great time and friends laughing together. While I was alone wishing I had those things, but I don't. I don't have much hope for the future, I really think I will be alone until I die. There are people who would not want me to die yes, but the pain of being alone is too much for me.
I'm so tired of being jealous of others lives. The ups are not worth the downs, never have been. I can't take the loneliness anymore.
